name: Upload: locate -> bypass -> execute -> OS proof
goal: From discovering the upload directory to executing uploaded code and proving the OS layer.
preconditions: Any file upload feature (avatar, ticket attachment, import).
impact: Remote code execution via uploaded script; full host compromise as the web user.

steps.purpose: Locate the upload directory and naming scheme (where files land, whether names are kept).
steps.on_success: Direct URL for the payload in step 2/3.
steps.on_fail: No listing -> derive paths from page source, JS, or error messages.

steps.purpose: Get a PHP-family payload past extension filtering (shell.php.jpg shape).
steps.on_fail: Validation stricter -> phtml/phar/phps/php5 variants, .htaccess/.user.ini drop, or content-type/filename normalization quirks.

steps.purpose: Prove the payload executes (php_uname marker) — upload becomes RCE.
steps.on_success: Step 4 for OS-layer proof; also try web/Stored XSS persisted marker for the XSS-flavored upload impact.
steps.on_fail: No execution -> pivot placement via web/Path traversal once-strip filter evasion (write outside upload dir).

steps.purpose: Converge on the deterministic uid() OS proof through the shell.
steps.on_success: Full chain narrative; proceed to internal recon.
steps.on_fail: Blind -> web/Command injection time-based sleep oracle.

entry_points: API upload endpoints from OpenAPI specs

recon.name: Upload-path reflection
recon.how: Check whether the response or subsequent pages echo the stored path/name — path knowledge is half the exploit.

recon.name: Extension acceptance matrix
recon.how: Probe the validator with a matrix (php3/phtml/phar/phps/jpg;php; .jpg/.php hybrids; case tricks; null byte legacy).
recon.signal: One variant stored where others rejected.

recon.name: Validation-code recovery
recon.how: Sourcemaps/source disclosure reveal the server-side validator; read before fuzzing.

recon.name: Archive upload angle
recon.how: Zip uploads with traversal names (zip slip) place files outside the upload root.

recon.name: Cloud upload diff
recon.how: Distinguish local storage vs S3/presigned — cloud storage changes the execution story to bucket takeover/public ACL.

pivot_hints: pair with directory listing for fleet-wide uploaded payloads
combine with deserialization-ladder via phar:// for PHP
